subject: general
question:
Observe the given roughness grade symbol and identify the corresponding roughness grade number whose corresponding roughness value is 0.2 µm.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a6300ea10982f7c68315ee3e2ee1d0912ec50e4947f68a621393f6adb40125e.png]
solution:
The correct answer is __N4__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Roughness grade symbols__ are used to specify the surface finish of materials.
 
• The roughness value 0.2 µm corresponds to the roughness grade number __N4__.
 
• Surface roughness is a measure of the texture of a surface, quantified by the vertical deviations of the surface from its ideal form.
 
• Smaller roughness values represent smoother surfaces, while larger values indicate rougher surfaces.
 
• The roughness grade numbers (e.g., N1, N2, N3, N4) are standardized for engineering and manufacturing processes.
